Angelic Davis (angelic.davis@enron.com) sent 6 unique messages to dana.davis@enron.com between 2001-10-01 and 2001-11-01. Dana Davis was in To on five of them and in Cc on the other one. I counted each message id once.

ANSWER: 6
SOURCES: Eec51ca95dc10, E78c208665714, Ea4671be47808, Ea9e43a0d11aa, Ef703ce92e611

Jeff Dasovich sent the most messages to Richard Sanders in that window. I filtered for messages with richard.sanders@enron.com in To or Cc dated 2001-05-29 up to but not including 2001-06-05. That gave 37 unique messages, and I counted them by sender.

Dasovich sent 8. Susan Mara was next with 5, then Janette Elbertson with 4 and Andrew Edison with 3.

ANSWER: jeff.dasovich@enron.com
SOURCES: Ec64a0fe2fe15, Efbeffae21bed, Eb4461cb03bfd, E89c6a95fd0e2, Eaa28b1519008

eSource@ENRON (40enron@enron.com) sent the most messages on 2001-09-05, with 23. The next highest days were 2001-09-28 with 19 and 2001-09-14 with 16. In total, 160 messages from that address are dated September 2001. I counted them by UTC date from the message metadata. I didn't read any message bodies. The source ID below is one of that address's September 2001 messages, not specifically one from the 5th.

ANSWER: 2001-09-05
SOURCES: E80e4adf85ec0

Vince Kaminski sent the most messages in April 2001 to vkaminski@aol.com, with 173 unique messages. I counted every message he sent that month and tallied each address in To or Cc once per message.

His own address, vince.kaminski@enron.com, was next at 135, but that is him writing to himself. Among other people, the top recipient was shirley.crenshaw@enron.com with 54.

I didn't open any messages to check them. I also didn't confirm that vkaminski@aol.com is his personal account.

ANSWER: vkaminski@aol.com
SOURCES:

The reference ORE-7509 appears in one message, **E2083b9620d07**. It was sent on 2002-02-27 with the subject "(CMS-26) NOTICE OF INTENTION TO TRANSFER MEMBERSHIP".

The sender is marketing@nymex.com, shown as "Exchange Information @ENRON". The message is in the deleted_items folder of custodian shackleton-s. The matching line reads "Edward Orenchuk (ORE-7509)", so the reference belongs to a person named in the notice. That person is not the sender.

ANSWER: marketing@nymex.com
SOURCES: E2083b9620d07

SOURCES: E2093dccd9417
